title.es: Estrellas en tu pantalla de inicio

text.en: See the top reader and everyone's stars on the Home Screen without opening the game.
text.lt: Matyk pirmaujantį skaitytoją ir visų žvaigždes pagrindiniame ekrane, neatidaręs žaidimo.
text.es: Ve al líder y las estrellas de todos en la pantalla de inicio sin abrir el juego.

text.en: Type a player's name in the widget's Parameter to show just their tokens.
text.lt: Įrašyk žaidėjo vardą valdiklio parametre ir matysi tik jo žetonus.
text.es: Escribe el nombre de un jugador en el parámetro del widget para ver solo sus fichas.

text.en: Works offline and on the Lock Screen, and never shows money, budgets or the PIN.
text.lt: Veikia be interneto ir užrakinimo ekrane, niekada nerodo pinigų, biudžetų ar PIN.
text.es: Funciona sin conexión y en la pantalla bloqueada; nunca muestra dinero ni el PIN.

changes: Home Screen and Lock Screen widget in the shared frame of the other apps (widgets blueprint 1.0.0): the Reading Stars star and name, the top reader with ⭐ points and 🪙 tokens to spend, the other players ranked as on the leaderboard (medium and large) and the number of players
Widget Parameter: a player's name shows only that player, with their tokens as the big number and their place on the leaderboard
Lock Screen: "⭐ Ema leads with 120" inline, the leader's points in the circle, the leaderboard line in the rectangle
The widget follows the game's language (Lithuanian, English, Spanish) and shows only names, avatars, points and tokens: never token values, budgets, payouts or the PIN
The widget reads a small snapshot saved after every round, payout and player change, so it works offline; data older than 12 hours shows "⟳ Updated …" in amber
Parent zone › Settings › Widget: how often iOS is asked to refresh it (30 min) and when it counts as out of date (720 min)
Built with lists the widgets blueprint
fixes: A widget pointing at Reading Stars no longer shows Scriptable's error ("Presenting a configured web view is not supported"): the game's start-up now runs only when the game is opened

text.en: A big yellow star with a sparkle and a teal reading line.
text.lt: Didelė geltona žvaigždė su žybsniu ir žalsva skaitymo linija.
text.es: Una gran estrella amarilla con un destello y una línea de lectura turquesa.

text.en: The star pops in and the tagline appears for about 2 seconds; tap to skip.
text.lt: Žvaigždė iššoka ir apie 2 sekundes rodomas šūkis; paspausk, kad praleistum.
text.es: La estrella aparece y el lema se muestra unos 2 segundos; toca para saltarlo.

text.en: The star sits on top of the home screen and in the README.
text.lt: Žvaigždė puikuojasi pradžios ekrano viršuje ir README.
text.es: La estrella está arriba en la pantalla principal y en el README.

changes: New Reading Stars logo (the big star): docs/logo.svg and a 1024 px app icon, docs/icon-1024.png

Launch screen shown for 2.4 s with a short animation and the tagline in the game's language (Read. Match. Shine. / Skaityk. Rask. Spindėk. / Lee. Elige. Brilla.); tap to skip; still with Reduce Motion; follows the shared launch-screen blueprint 1.0.0
The logo replaces the book and star emoji at the top of the home screen, and heads the README
Built with lists the launch-screen blueprint

text.en: Six colour themes for parents to choose, including a calm night sky.
text.lt: Šešios spalvų temos tėvams pasirinkti, tarp jų ramus naktinis dangus.
text.es: Seis temas de color para que elijan los padres, con un cielo nocturno tranquilo.

title.es: Texto más grande o más pequeño

text.en: Text size and layout to fit every reader; the game word still fills the card.
text.lt: Teksto dydis ir išdėstymas kiekvienam skaitytojui; žaidimo žodis vis tiek užpildo kortelę.
text.es: Tamaño de texto y diseño para cada lector; la palabra del juego sigue llenando la tarjeta.

title.es: Ajustes de padres en un solo lugar

text.en: Letter style, sounds, money, PIN, round sizes and updates, behind the PIN.
text.lt: Raidžių stilius, garsai, pinigai, PIN, raundų dydis ir atnaujinimai – už PIN kodo.
text.es: Estilo de letra, sonidos, dinero, PIN, tamaño de rondas y actualizaciones, tras el PIN.

changes: New Settings sheet in the parent zone (sliders icon, behind the PIN): Appearance, Game, Money, Parent, Updates with Check now, Rounds and Built with; changes apply at once, in Lithuanian, English or Spanish
Appearance shared with the other apps: six palettes plus Auto (the bright Ink look stays the default), Comfortable, Compact or Tiny layout, four text sizes, rounded or serif headings
Night and Slate palettes give the game a night sky; picture tiles, syllable colours and the copybook word card stay the same in every palette
Tiny layout: one line per player on the leaderboard and in the parent zone; tap a player for the details. The game screen is unchanged
Pictures per round can be set: Beginner 2–4 (3), Expert 3–5 (5)
Letter style, currency and sounds move from data.json to settings.json in the same folder, automatically; players, tokens, budgets and the PIN stay in data.json
Built with: the blueprints this app follows, with links to read them

text.en: The game tells you when a new version is out, and waits two days if you tap Later.
text.lt: Žaidimas praneša apie naują versiją, o paspaudus „Vėliau“ palaukia dvi dienas.
text.es: El juego avisa cuando hay versión nueva y espera dos días si tocas Más tarde.

text.en: Update right from the game. No need to run the installer again.
text.lt: Atnaujink tiesiai žaidime, diegimo scenarijaus nebereikia.
text.es: Actualiza desde el juego, sin volver a usar el instalador.

text.en: Every update shows its three best features before you install it.
text.lt: Prieš diegiant matysi tris geriausias atnaujinimo naujoves.
text.es: Cada actualización muestra sus tres mejores novedades antes de instalarla.

changes: Update check on start, with an update sheet in Lithuanian, English and Spanish
Update now downloads the new script over the running one; Later hides the offer for 2 days
The update sheet appears only on the home screen, never during a round
Version number on the home screen and in the parent zone
CONFIG.CHECK_UPDATES switch to turn update checks off
releases.json, CHANGELOG.md, tools/changelog.js and docs/RELEASING.md

text.en: Big syllable-split words with 3 or 5 pictures that all start with the same letter.
text.lt: Dideli žodžiai skiemenimis ir 3 ar 5 paveikslėliai iš tos pačios raidės.
text.es: Palabras grandes por sílabas con 3 o 5 dibujos que empiezan por la misma letra.

text.en: +1 for a correct read, −1 for a wrong tap, shown as pocket money in a big wallet.
text.lt: +1 už teisingą, −1 už klaidą, o vertė pinigais matoma didelėje piniginėje.
text.es: +1 por acertar, −1 por fallar, y su valor en dinero en una gran cartera.

text.en: Set each kid's token value and hidden budget, top up and pay out behind a PIN.
text.lt: Su PIN kodu nustatykite žetono vertę, slaptą biudžetą, papildykite ir išmokėkite.
text.es: Con PIN: valor de ficha, presupuesto oculto, recargas y canjes por niño.

changes: Picture-and-word reading game for Scriptable with Lithuanian, English and Spanish (about 190–200 words each)
Beginner (ages 4–6): 1–2 syllables, 3 pictures; Expert (ages 9–11): 3–6 syllables, 5 pictures
All pictures in a round start with the word's first letter
Kid profiles with name, level and avatar; leaderboard with podium and all-time points
+1 token for a correct first try, −1 for each wrong tap (never below 0)
Big animated wallet showing tokens and their money value
Parent zone behind a 4-digit PIN: per-kid token value, hidden budget, top-ups, payouts and history
Kids are told to ask for a top-up when the budget can't cover their tokens
Word letter style, currency and sound settings
One-line installer (install.js)
fixes: Black screen on start caused by the old save loop
Parent zone could not open after adding a player in the same session
